sampleIntegrity.note: 1859 of 8201 settled rows (22.7%) are pending orders that resolved on their own fill bar, where the OHLC cannot show the entry printed before the exit. If the exit printed first the order was still resting and there was no trade, so each row is either what the walk scored (511 wins, 1348 losses) or not a sample point at all. That puts the win rate between 27.95% and 38.82% — an interval, not a measurement. Only a finer series inside the fill bar can narrow it (scripts/resolve-unprovable-1m.mjs).
